headline: Battle Lines Cool, But Divided Fronts Stir
war_summary: The latest ledger finds the great contested sectors quieter at the base level, though the guns have not fallen silent everywhere. LinnMercyHex still leads the movement report with twenty events in twenty-four hours, despite none in the last two; its line remains divided, ten Colonial bases to one Warden. StonecradleHex likewise records seventeen daily events and no fresh movement in six hours, while heavy losses and accelerating two-hour rates continue around its three Warden and six Colonial positions. WeatheredExpanseHex has six Warden bases against three Colonial, with eleven daily events but no recent flips; casualties are again accelerating over the past two hours. StlicanShelfHex remains split five to four after four daily events. DeadLandsHex shows five events and renewed two-hour casualty acceleration, though its eleven bases remain Colonial. The newest visible turnover is in GutterHex, where two events have just been recorded and the count stands six Warden to one Colonial. FishermansRowHex, active in the previous edition, has gone quiet in the latest two-hour window.
